mass_source: Assumption: no sourced curb weight for the 1891 car; wooden chassis, front V-twin, three-speed gearbox, iron-hubbed artillery wheels.

steering_servo.note: Driver's grip on the tiller (0.30 m arm: 60 N m is 200 N at the grip).

tire.note: Solid rubber on artillery wheels: round crown and compliant contact, as learned on the Velo (flat stiff cylinders chatter when cornering).

assumptions: Mass split, centre of mass (front engine, behind the front axle) and inertia are estimates; no occupants.
